case_title: JAKIA NASIM AHESAN & ANR. v. STATE OF GUJARAT & ORS.
neutral_facts: The accused, a woman, was the wife of a deceased individual who was killed in an incident that occurred in the Gulberg Society area of Ahmedabad. An FIR was registered by the police at the Meghaninagar Police Station. After the investigation, a charge-sheet was filed, and the case was committed to the Court of Sessions. The accused submitted a complaint alleging that certain individuals in positions of power conspired with the State Administration, including the Police, to aid and abet the incidents. The accused sought registration of another FIR against these individuals for various offenses. The police declined to take cognizance of her complaint, leading her to file a petition before the High Court. The High Court dismissed the petition, stating that the accused could approach the investigating agency for further investigation. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) was directed to look into the complaint. The SIT conducted further investigations and submitted a report. The Amicus Curiae examined the report and submitted his own findings. The Supreme Court directed the SIT to forward its final report to the Court that had taken cognizance of the original FIR, emphasizing that the trial court would handle the matter thereafter.
